facts.fact: Rory 随 Gabriel 到 Themis 神庙礼拜：黑色大理石巨殿里熏香浓重（菖蒲根、罂粟、鼠尾草），中央是暗红色大水池，池中立起几百英尺高的大理石柱，池边石台刻着天平浮雕并垂挂铁链，前台两侧各有火盆。
facts.anchor: Incense hung thick and heavy in a cavernous temple of dark marble. It smelled of calamus root, poppy, and sage.

facts.fact: 礼拜时 Gabriel 紧贴 Rory 而坐、腿贴着腿，十指相扣把交握的手放在自己腿上；他凑到耳边问玫瑰是否合意，Rory 表面 sweet smile，实则对触碰本能退缩。
facts.anchor: Gabriel sat on the other side of me, his thigh pressed against mine, and he took my hand into his, threading our fingers together and pulling our adjoined hands to rest on his lap.

facts.fact: 三名祭司讲道一小时（内容是颂扬 Torrish 的高压反亵渎、称 Themis 把 seraph 从堕落与战乱中解救）之后，国王 Torrish 起立宣布今天要以一场赎罪礼（atonement）敬 Themis，命卫队长带罪人进来；贵族们兴奋骚动。
facts.anchor: King Torrish rose from his dark marble throne. “Today we have an atonement to bring forth in celebration and worship of Themis.” An oily smile slid across his face.

facts.fact: Rory 认出被按倒在石台上的正是那天她与 Darragh 进城时卖糕点给她的商人 seraph；Darragh 保持石头般的冷漠，用银镣铐锁住其手腕以封住他的 enchant。
facts.anchor: There, being pushed prone on the marble block, was the merchant seraph who sold me the pastries in the market the day I went into the city with Darragh.

facts.fact: 国王当众宣判商人 Russtoph Fornix：在其商贩车里搜出假神 Hestia 的木雕像；在 Edenalee，Hestia 是滋养女神、许多厨师烘焙师设坛供奉以求食物安全；国王当众把雕像丢进火里烧毁。
facts.anchor: “Russtoph Fornix!” The king’s booming, deep voice echoed in the chamber. A velvet bag the size of a melon dangled from his clenched fist. “You have been found with a false idol of worship, hidden in your merchant cart. The false goddess, Hestia!”

facts.fact: 国王借「与 Themis 通灵」宣布判罚：银头鞭抽打十下；行刑荣誉授予卫队长 Darragh，还当众提到他曾在城里从窃贼手中救过 Rory；Rory 想带 Cora 离场，被 Gabriel 抓着手拒绝，称罪人受罚必须有见证才算是赎罪、并说这是「美事」。
facts.anchor: “I have consorted with Themis and have been told the atonement that he desires out of Russtoph for his blatant disrespect to the one true and just God. Ten lashings with a silver-tipped whip.

facts.fact: Darragh 毫不迟疑挥鞭抽裂 Russtoph 被扒开衣服的背、血溅入池，Russtoph 惨叫；Rory 用手臂捂住 Cora 的耳朵、用手挡住她的眼睛；Darragh 一连抽完十鞭毫无犹豫，事后把血鞭交还侍从径直离场，路过时只瞥了 Rory 与 Gabriel 交握的手和她脸上的泪，毫无反应。
facts.anchor: Darragh didn’t hesitate and cracked the whip, slicing open Russtoph’s tender, exposed flesh. Blood splattered into the pool, and Russtoph screamed.

facts.fact: 目睹行刑，Rory 对 Darragh 日渐加深的爱意瞬间崩塌——自 Micah 之后她再没与谁如此贴近；她自责此前无视过他危险的 ferocity、昨晚还对他动怒，认定他如众人警告的那样会变成怪物，泪水滚落。
facts.anchor: My feelings for him had been deepening each day, and I hadn’t felt so connected to someone since Micah had come into my life. That had all been ripped out of me in an agonizing instant.

facts.fact: 散场后 Cora 哀求母亲别再带她来神庙，说自己声音被捂住但看见了持鞭的队长、被吓坏；Percie 王子邀 Cora 晚宴同坐，被 Rory 以身体不适推掉；Rory 决定今晚潜入 Gabriel 办公室找那本 mead 配方书——在 Tironaill 多待一天，她们母女的危险就多一分。
facts.anchor: “Mom, please don’t make me come to this place again,” she whispered in a heartbreaking voice.
